text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. It is also important to get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to work properly. Good mental health matters too, so make time to relax and talk to friends. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Do not spend all your time working or studying. Enjoy your free time, and remember that small healthy habits can make a big difference.
